odvs.description: win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds is the variable used to set when Windows notices inactivity of a logon session, and if the amount of inactive time exceeds the inactivity limit, then the screen saver will run, locking the session. The recommended state for this setting is: 900 or fewer second(s), but not 0.
odvs.name: inactivity_timeout_seconds

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.3 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Machine inactivity limit is set to 900 or fewer seconds but not 0"
  when: win22cis_rule_2_3_7_3
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.7.3
    - patch
    - logon
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.10
    - NIST800-171_3.1.11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_5
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-12
  block:
    - name: "2.3.7.3 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Machine inactivity limit is set to 900 or fewer seconds but not 0 | Apply Settings To Registry"
      when:
        - win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds <= 900
        - win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds > 0
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System
        name: InactivityTimeoutSecs
        data: "{{ win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "2.3.7.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon Machine inactivity limit is set to 900 or fewer seconds but not 0 | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds > 900 or
          win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds == 0
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of seconds set for win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.7.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon Machine inactivity limit is set to 900 or fewer seconds but not 0 | Warn Count"
      when: win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds > 900 or
          win22cis_inactivity_timeout_seconds == 0
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.7.3'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
